notes.title: Patch 1.04
notes.notes:
Hi!

Please find a couple of bug fixes and gameplay improvements.

Cheers,
Paper Beast Team

--- Patch Notes ---
SandBox:
- Fix Bridger behaviour that can be stuck in front of Voraxo.
- Allow entities to reproduce more that palette limit per entity.
- Bridgers, Papyvorus, Predators, insects can reproduce 2 or 3 entities at a time if population is high.

Chapter 3.4: Make sure player have enough "Bridger" in any situation

notes.title: HotFix 1.03
notes.notes:
Hi!

This patch fixes a rare save issue for players who launched the Folded edition before patching to 1.02. It now makes sure to keep saved progression between VR and Folded edition.

Cheers,
Paper Beast Team

notes.title: Patch 1.02 - Out Now!
notes.notes:
Hi!

Please find a couple of bug fixes and improvements. It includes tweak and gameplay adjustments.

Cheers,
Paper Beast Team

--- Patch Notes ---

 Fix simulation terrain issue on older graphic cards than GTX 970 like GTX 780
 Fix refresh of terrain water flux when changing graphics settings (no need to restart game now)
 SandBox: Fix plant above ground issue around the ShyPlant
 Fix some culling issue
 Chapter 4.2: Improve creatures behaviour for a more fluent gameplay
 Chapter 5.2: Improve big boulder cable manipulation. Improve predator behaviour near the big boulder
 Chapter 6.3: Up to 3 LCD cubes
 Chapter 7: Adding extra underwater visual

notes.title: PaperBeast Patch 1.01 is live!
notes.notes:
Release notes 1.01 :
- Fix Oculus SDK default sound output
- Fix Oculus Store launch of Steam game forcing OpenVR
- Add VR SDK autodetection
- Unlock story even if the player skips the introduction
- Shield potential corrupted saves
